newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iranian and Syrian officials met in Syria for talks to boost bilateral cooperation.
- A joint U.S.-Egyptian economic committee is due to meet in Washington on Monday.
- Arab countries' oil production increased five percent in the first quarter of 1997 compared with the same period a year earlier.
- Iran's National Guard chief denied he was resigning.
- Yemen is to give government employees a 10 percent cost of living rise.
